title: The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yakou Shizuka, a shy blind woman, works at a detective agency run by the invisible, gentlemanly Tounome. His invisibility does not fool her, which charms him, and he sets out to win her over while their quirky coworkers, including a beastwoman, look on (Seven Seas blurb via AniList/MU; Otaku USA).
life_message: Love grows from being truly perceived by someone, whatever others can or cannot see.

content.note: Tounome gets hurt and bleeds in one scene (Otaku USA).
Laid-back office slice of life (Otaku USA).
Adult office romance; boss pursues his employee (blurb); accidental lap-sitting gag (Otaku USA). Physical content not reported (to verify).
Boss-subordinate romance using his 'skills' to woo her (blurb); how consent is framed to verify.
